data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002 conflates causal-history equivalence with the problem's actual standard — 'append-only identity of the recorded events.' The target itself concedes 'no committed event was modified or deleted,' yet still demands refusal on the grounds that re-entering a partially-flushed atomic step 'produces a different causal history.' But append-only identity is a property of the committed event log, not of the internal causal trajectory of computation. By imposing a stricter invariant (causal-history fidelity) than the problem requires, SRC_002 over-refuses: it would block resumption in cases where the recorded events' append-only identity is fully intact.
